description: Read the names and gave out the rolls.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave Bolingbroke flat, and called for the stool.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Asked whether to stop, and offered an arm as far as the gate.
name: John Heminges

description: Took the Groom's roll, the last in the bag.
name: John Sincler

description: Found the joins on the second reading, and called the stool the best thing in it.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Stood with his hand out, and took the jig as a groat in settlement of a pound.
name: Will Kemp

description: Had his hand out for the basket, and put it under the stair.
name: William Sly

description: Asked for the plain reading, stooped for the basket, and played Gaunt from the stool.
name: William Shakespeare
